Stillflow

releases.name: Pitchside Empire
releases.summary: Find out if you are still a complete moron, or a total genius?If you've often pondered this question, ponder no more--just get The Stupid Test 2 for iOS. Pretty soon you'll be answering crazy questions--careful, many are designed to trip you up! Can you figure out the sometimes oblique answers (and do you know what oblique means)? If you can puzzle out these mind-benders, you'll get a high IQ score and impress your friends.Features:- 45 fun, addicting stages- Checkpoints in each section of the quiz- Beautiful hand drawn graphics- Compare and test it with your friends! Fun for all ages

releases.name: Level P
releases.summary: You are lost in an underground car park. Use your key fob to find your car. Every ping tells you where to go. Every ping tells something else where you are.

releases.name: Grey Cloaks of Aron: The Sleeping Village
releases.summary: A story-driven 2D detective adventure set in a mysterious medieval village. Explore locations, examine crime scenes, gather clues, talk to locals, uncover dark secrets, and play alone or in local co-op.

releases.name: BLACK STACK
releases.summary: THE SURVEILLANCE METER IS THE REAL BOSSThe Black Stack is a sentient corporate megastructure that placed divinity behind a permission gate.You are unauthorized.Build a forbidden deck. Steal hardware. Compile one-shot exploits. Climb toward the process that wrote God - and decide how much evidence to leave behind.Protocols raise TRACE, which persists between encounters and crosses PING, LOCK, PURGE, and TERMINAL thresholds. Each arms a new response. High Trace distorts the interface and enemy intent; at 100, one grace cycle precedes escalating nonlethal Integrity loss. Vent it - or turn surveillance into fuel.COMPILE YOUR OWN VERSIONChoose from three playable identities, each with a distinct body, starting kit, card pool, and power:VANTA // THE APOSTATE - disciplined Bandwidth and Trace control through OVERCLOCK.THE ARCHON KERNEL - stolen authority that turns dangerous Trace into power.THE COURIER - a script-runner whose exploit inventory drives the deck.The catalog contains 503 card definitions: 496 playable protocols and seven hostile Status injections. Build across Attacks, Skills, Powers, and 60 dedicated WAGER protocols. The wider library adds 78 relics, 66 exploit scripts, 16 Divine elixirs, 12 Ultras, five Graft Cores, and 12 Machine God blessings.POWER LEAVES A SIGNALAcross 496 playable protocols and 172 relics, scripts, elixirs, and Ultras, dozens of engines are waiting to be discovered - and broken open.Power earned through play is allowed to feel powerful. We do not flatten an engine merely because it became obscene. Your LOADOUT SIGNAL lets Intelligent difficulty read rarity, mastery, equipment, and graft investment, then scale the Stack around you. Prefer a ceiling? Select Capped response. Add one of three Audit contracts for greater resistance and rewards.PHYSICAL COPIES. PERMANENT MASTERY.Recover schematics, spend Salvage to compile as many physical copies as you can afford, and build a ten-card opening manifest for each identity. Removed starters return to your library.Basic through Rare protocols reach level 3; Divine protocols reach level 4.Rare capstones and every Divine rank fork permanently, so copies of one card can become different weapons.Maxed cards gain animated mastery chrome and rarity-aware play effects.Wager protocols turn coin calls, dice, loaded reels, Blackjack, and roulette into seeded combat engines with bespoke animations.SIX ACTS TO ROOT TERMINUSClimb a branching, seeded ascent through five atlases, then enter ROOT TERMINUS: a straight eight-layer procession toward Archon Prime and its Ascendant second body.Face 81 hostile processes and 58 authored event definitions, including eight adaptive Forensic Processes.Fight multi-enemy encounters with individual intents and direct targeting.Hunt elite variants and confront bespoke authorities - including one you can negotiate with.At Archon checkpoints, repair, vent, extract a prize, or continue deeper.Use REVOCATION once per run to reject a filed death and return at 1 HP and 0 Trace. The enemy's exact Integrity, Block, status, form, and intent remain; every player card returns to the deck.ACCEPT THE MANDATE - OR REVOKE ITA forbidden offer can transform your identity and unlock THE MANDATE: a second six-act campaign that turns the route inside out and sends you against ten new authorities.Protect the system you once breached, pursue older powers, or revoke your appointment and return to the oath. The Archive remembers which version chose.THE STACK LEARNS HOW YOU FIGHTCombat Doctrine records your openers, sequences, Bandwidth use, defense, targets, Trace appetite, wagers, and equipment. The Stack uses those habits in Forensic Processes - and when archived versions return.Failed and strongest selves can rebuild their real deck, mastery branches, equipment, resources, piles, and learned doctrine. The most dangerous encounter may be the version that mastered your own engine first.DESCEND BELOW THE STACKA route can fracture into the DEEP BREACH, a rare once-per-run exception that suspends your exact atlas and opens an eight-stop illegal descent.Three authorities. Two corrupted casinos. A Divine cache. An apex boss. Extraction.Escape and the original atlas reconnects where it broke, contraband intact. Die below the Stack and the run ends. Complete a naturally filed descent to recover the secret Godscar Engine Graft Core.THE BLACK ARCHIVE REMEMBERS EVERY VERSIONRecovery Catalog + Workbench - unlock and compile components, construct manifests, and master individual copies.Graft Foundry - install one of five cores and commit to one of 15 doctrines across 150 authored nodes. Reset for a full Salvage refund.The Ascent - infinite, non-seasonal progression. Complete twelve-node chapters for Gems and new deterministic reward lines.Breach Archive + Memory Index - reopen run maps and telemetry; catalog encountered processes, origins, art, and lore.NULLCADE - two permanent cabinets: BREACHEROIDS and the seven-stage NULLSPIRE, with persistent scores and bounded rewards.THE HOUSE ALWAYS COLLECTSWager Dens select deterministic Blackjack or an animated 3x3 reel machine. Between runs, spend earned Gems at Big Six for XP, Salvage, property, or an unowned Divine protocol. Every stake uses fictional currency earned only through play.ONE PRICE. THE COMPLETE GAME.Everything here is included in one purchase and earned through play.No microtransactions, paid currency, card packs, paid battle pass, loot boxes, real-money wagering, or cash-out.SHARED RULES. YOUR DECISIONS.Every run is deterministic; share a BREACH CODE to replay its route.SCHEDULED AUDITS are seeded challenges with fixed identity, kit, route, and modifier.A guided tutorial teaches combat, Trace, Block, the Archive, deck construction, mastery, grafts, and loadouts.Save and resume route and combat state, with Steam Cloud reconciliation.BUILT FOR THE WHOLE RUN60 Steam achievements and 31 interface languages.Keyboard, mouse, and gamepad navigation.Separate audio, display, atmosphere, post FX, shake, impact, and reduced-motion settings.Card inspection, forecasts, reactive music, cinematics, hit-stop, shield fractures, kill dissolves, particles, and atmosphere.The Stack is generating another version of you.

releases.name: Nebulon
releases.summary: Nebulon is a minimalist but challenging puzzle game set in a distant nebula. Help some small cube-shaped robots collect all batteries in their enclosure, they then gain the energy to destroy the walls and are able to escape!

releases.name: Barrel Chess
releases.summary: Four chessboards. One barrel. Every "safe" square you know is a lie here. Chess just lost its edges, and so did your confidence. Four boards fused into one barrel. Same rules, no walls, nowhere to trap a king. Face BarrelBot, running real Stockfish Engine across all 4 boards.

releases.name: Fill the Blank: 1st Story
releases.summary: Our Imperfect Romantic Comedy, 「Fill the Blank」1st Story. Love Comedy Visual Novel.

releases.name: Childhood Slots
releases.summary: Buy once, play forever. 4 cozy slot machines. No ads, no in-app purchases, fully offline.

releases.name: Tarot Gambit
releases.summary: Tarot Gambit is a 1v1 tarot duel against the Devil. Draw blindly: each Arcana brings healing or sudden death. Use relics to spy, sabotage, and turn the tables. In endless mode, bet chips each round — lose them all and you're out, or cash out anytime. A candlelit battle of memory, nerve, and bluff.

releases.name: Nellie's Nonograms
releases.summary: A collection of Nonograms made by friends and fans of the vtuber NellieAndGrits, an avid nonograms enjoyer.

releases.name: Escape The Construction Site
releases.summary: Escape a dangerous construction site by finding the only safe path to the exit. Hidden speeding dump trucks punish every wrong turn, so memorize the route through trial and error and survive long enough to escape.

releases.name: Fortune Factory
releases.summary: Fortune Factory is a luck‑based game where you create dice, sell crates, upgrade your factory and slowly build your fortune. Roll the perfect crate to win — or progress step by step. It’s just you and your luck.

releases.name: Mox Modular
releases.summary: Help the gnome village of Mox Modular to grow in this incremental game. Play minigames, earn resources and build new buildings to progress. Can you earn all the achievements to make the village thrive?

releases.name: POSER
releases.summary: POSER is a narrative-driven rhythm game where you move to the beat to explore an underground club, and dance battle your way through it to uncover its darkest secrets.

releases.name: DesktopDrifter.exe
releases.summary: Turn your desktop into a drifting playground. Drive a tiny car across your screen, perform drifts, unlock cosmetic cars, smoke effects and more. Keep the ride going while you work, browse or relax.

releases.name: Summon Stone
releases.summary: A fusion of puzzles and tower defense! Use puzzles to break summon stones and summon monsters corresponding to those stones. Switch between two decks to stack and destroy summon stones, then summon monsters. Summon powerful monsters with massive chain reactions and overwhelm your enemies.

releases.name: Tank Odyssey
releases.summary: Enter fast-paced tank arenas where sharp movement and quick decisions are the keys to survival. Fight relentless enemies, switch between four distinct weapons and take on a new challenge in every level - hunt for hidden keys, capture zones, complete time trials and more!Battle through 20 increasingly difficult levels across the Arcade, Void, Paper and Distort arenas, then test your skills in four objective-free Endless modes. Stay mobile, master every weapon and survive the chaos in Tank Odyssey.
